n: DM NUX USB over Network Wall Plate with Routing, Local, White (DM-NUX-L2-1G-W)
d: DM-NUX-L2-1G-W DM NUX USB over Network Wall Plate with Routing, Local, White

specs.label: LINK Speed
specs.value: Up to 480 Mbps, dependent upon network speed and quality

specs.label: USB Device Support
specs.value: USB 1.0/1.1 and 2.0 with Hub compatible including isochronous devices

specs.label: USB Hub Support
specs.value: Any signal chain may include up to 4 USB hubs plus one DM‑NUX‑L2‑1G and one DM‑NUX‑R2‑1G

specs.label: Maximum USB Devices
specs.value: 30 USB devices, or 4 USB hubs with 26 USB devices

specs.label: Host Computer OS Support
specs.value: Windows®, macOS®, and Linux® operating systems

specs.label: USB Throughput
specs.value: USB 2.0 up to 480 Mbps, USB 1.1 up to 12 Mbps

specs.label: Construction
specs.value: Metal, black finish with white or black polycarbonate label overlay

specs.label: Flush Wall Mount
specs.value: Mounts in an unobstructed North American 1-gang electrical box (not included); FP-G1 series decorator style faceplate (not included)
